---
title: "Lab 06 — Reversion to the mean and correlation versus causation"
output: learnr::tutorial
runtime: shiny_prerendered
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(tidyverse)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("../R/lab_submission.R")
set.seed(6)
n <- 400
stable <- rnorm(n, 50, 10)
sim <- tibble(
  wave1 = stable + rnorm(n, 0, 8),
  wave2 = stable + rnorm(n, 0, 8)
)
lab_meta <- list(id = "lab06", title = "Reversion to the mean")
lab_prompts <- c(
  q1 = "If you keep only the top 10% on wave 1, their wave-2 mean usually…",
  q2 = "That drop happens even when…",
  q3 = "A cross-section of countries is enough to show reversion to the mean.",
  q4 = "A ministry credits a program because the worst districts improved next year. What is the rival story?"
)
```

## What you will do

See reversion without a treatment, and keep it separate from a causal claim. Download the `.txt`.

```{r extremes, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=6}
hi <- sim |> filter(wave1 >= quantile(wave1, 0.90))
hi |> summarise(mean_wave1 = mean(wave1), mean_wave2 = mean(wave2))
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("Moves closer to the middle.", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Stays just as extreme, if there is no program."),
  answer("Falls only if a program failed."),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("There is no treatment. Part of the extreme score was noise.", correct = TRUE),
  answer("The analyst includes a lagged dependent variable."),
  allow_retry = TRUE
)
```

```{r q3}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  answer("False. Reversion needs the same units measured twice.", correct = TRUE),
  answer("True. One year of GDP is two waves."),
  allow_retry = TRUE
)
```

```{r q4}
question_text(lab_prompts[["q4"]], open_answer(), trim = TRUE)
```

## Submit

```{r submit-ui, echo=FALSE}
shiny::textInput("student_name", "Your name", placeholder = "Name Surname")
shiny::downloadButton("download_txt", "Download submission .txt")
```

```{r submit-server, context="server"}
output$download_txt <- shiny::downloadHandler(
  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
  content = function(file) {
    write_lab_submission(
      path = file,
      name = input$student_name,
      lab_id = lab_meta$id,
      lab_title = lab_meta$title,
      state = shiny::reactiveValuesToList(learnr::get_tutorial_state()),
      prompts = lab_prompts
    )
  }
)
```
